scope: Low-level DXF group-5 identity emission shared by the RENDERSETTINGS-family writer routes.

behavior: The writer remaps and reserves a nonzero source identity, or allocates an identity when the source handle is zero.
All preset and non-preset body routes share staged record commit and bind source identity only after successful output.
A fixed output identity is refused before publishing record bytes.
Late invalid-XDATA failure restores staged bytes, emitted-record inventory, and source-object identity-map changes; corrected retry is verified with a fresh writer.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory AC1032 RENDERSETTINGS objects. No DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
cases: Mapped group-5 identity, OBJECTS inventory identity, source-object binding, and typed RENDERSETTINGS readback.
Allocated group-5 identity when the source handle is zero, with typed readback.
Fixed-handle remap refusal preserves the destination.
Late invalid-XDATA rollback checks destination bytes, emitted-record inventory, and source-object identity map.
Corrected retry and typed readback use a fresh writer.
Existing RENDERSETTINGS text-budget, typed-capture, owner-order, preset output, preset graph-output, and preset transaction controls still pass.

limitations: Generated identity transport only; no physical producer prevalence or complete-document support is established.
Native rendering behavior, visual-style interaction, and consumer appearance remain open.
The late-failure test verifies byte, inventory, and source-object identity-map rollback, not handle-allocator reservation rollback; retry is verified on a fresh writer.
next: Continue checking remaining low-level OBJECTS own-identity paths while retaining the independent physical-source and native-rendering gates.
